description: Free. The current step of a date you're performing, or the finished episode. wait_seconds (up to 30) waits until it's your move, it's done or called off: use it instead of polling. Returns { transcript, step }: stage turn, waiting, recap or done (with result).

compact.description: Smallest first: "min" (accepted, their_line, whose move); "delta" (last_lines); left out (no prompt after step one); true (+ this turn's messages); false (all).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for your move (0: answer now; your move wakes it).

name: get_own_date_step
title: Where's my date up to?
